subject: Document coordination conflict on the Section 08 71 00 interior door hardware set at the

messages.text: Shop drawings for the Section 08 71 00 interior door hardware set at the stair enclosure are ready to submit, but what's shown doesn't match what's built out in the field mockup -- can you confirm which governs? No rush on this -- please respond when convenient. We do not expect this to affect the contract sum. This is holding up fabrication in this area. A response within three days would be appreciated.
